source: Babel native linter (gold-non-bg) and Babel Helper custom linter; generated by tools/lint-parity/generate.mjs

reasons.NULL_TIMESTAMPS: Segment must have both start and end timestamps.
reasons.DOUBLE_SPACES: Double spaces are not allowed in text.
reasons.LEADING_TRAILING_SPACES: Extra spaces at the end or beginning of segments are not allowed.
reasons.NSS_TAG_SPACING: Non-speech sound tags need a space on each side, e.g. word [laugh] word.
reasons.CJK_HALF_WIDTH_SPACE: Half-width space found between CJK characters.
reasons.MULTIPLE_ASTERISKS: Multiple asterisks in a row (**, ***, etc.) are not allowed.
reasons.EMPTY_EMPHASIS: Empty emphasis (*  *) is not allowed - add text between asterisks.
reasons.PUNCTUATION_INSIDE_EMPHASIS: Punctuation should be outside emphasis asterisk.
reasons.SPACES_INSIDE_EMPHASIS: Emphasis asterisks go right against the word (*word*, not * word *).
reasons.EMPTY_CURLY_BRACKET: Empty curly brackets {} are not allowed.
reasons.UNCLOSED_CURLY_BRACKET: Curly brackets must be properly closed.
reasons.BARE_CURLY_COMMENT: Bare curly brackets {} are not allowed on transcriptions. Use {{ }} for reviewer comments, or a {PRO: word} / {MIS: word} tag.
reasons.CURLY_TAG_SPACING: Curly tags need a space before the brace and after the colon, e.g. 5 {PRO: five}.
reasons.BRACKET_SPACING: Spaces are not allowed within bracket tags.
reasons.STYLE_TAG_EMPTY_NAME: Style tag names cannot be empty
reasons.STYLE_TAG_WHITESPACE_IN_SYNTAX: No whitespace allowed inside tag markers
reasons.STYLE_TAG_UNMATCHED: Style tags must be properly matched and closed
reasons.STYLE_TAG_SPACING: Style tags must have spaces around them: 'word <tag> content </tag> word'
reasons.STYLE_TAG_PUNCTUATION_OUTSIDE: Punctuation should be inside style tags
reasons.TRIPLE_DASH: Triple or more dashes (---) are typically avoided.
reasons.SPACED_DOUBLE_DASH: Double dash should hug the preceding word (no space before --).
reasons.DOUBLE_DASH_PUNCTUATION: Punctuation immediately after double dash is typically avoided.
reasons.DOUBLE_DASH_MISSING_SPACE: Double dash mid-sentence should be followed by a space or closing quote.
reasons.SINGLE_DASH_MISSING_SPACE: Consider fixing: Single dash (stammer) should be followed by a space, unless the word is truly hyphenated or a contraction.
reasons.ELLIPSIS_MISSING_SPACE: Add a space after an ellipsis between two words, e.g. word... word.
reasons.UNRESOLVED_LOW_CONFIDENCE: This segment has unresolved low-confidence words. Please review and acknowledge or edit.
reasons.NO_ANGLE_BRACKETS: Angle brackets <> are not allowed in silver tier transcriptions.
reasons.NO_ASTERISKS: Asterisks for emphasis are not needed for silver tier transcriptions.
reasons.NO_CURLY_BRACKETS: Curly brackets {} are not allowed in silver tier transcriptions.
reasons.CONSECUTIVE_PUNCTUATION: Consecutive terminal punctuation or commas detected.
reasons.DUPLICATED_SEGMENTS: Exact duplicate of another segment in this transcript.
reasons.DUPLICATED_SEGMENTS_ADJACENT: Possible duplicate of the adjacent segment.
reasons.INTRA_SEGMENT_DUPLICATE: Repeated substring found within this segment.
reasons.ARABIC_FOREIGN_TAG_MISSING_LANG_MARKER: Foreign-language blocks must open with a {XX} language-code marker that has exactly one space on each side (e.g. <أجنبي> {EN} word </أجنبي>).
reasons.FULL_WIDTH_PUNCTUATION: ASCII punctuation found; use full-width forms (。！？，／；：) in C & J segments.
reasons.TRADITIONAL_CHINESE: Traditional Chinese character(s) detected; transcripts must use Simplified Chinese.
reasons.EMOJI: Emoji are not allowed in transcriptions.
reasons.EM_DASH: Em dash (—) and en dash (–) are not allowed. Use a standard dash with spaces on either side ( - ) instead.
reasons.PRO_TAG_NUMERALS: PRO tags should contain how the number was pronounced in the audio clip, using full words.
reasons.PAUSE_TAG_AT_BOUNDARY: Pause tags ([beat], [pause], [long-pause]) cannot be at the very beginning or end of a segment.
reasons.STYLE_TAG_ONLY_NONSPEECH: Style tag contains only non-speech sound tag(s) with no styled text content.
reasons.TAG_ONLY_PUNCTUATION: A segment that contains only a tag must not include any punctuation.
reasons.PARENTHESES: Parentheses are not used for transcription, with rare exceptions. Use [] or <> for tags, or {} for MIS/PRO/comments.
reasons.UNPAIRED_QUOTES: Quotation marks must come in pairs — this segment has an odd number of quotation marks.
reasons.NO_MIS_TAGS: MIS tags are not allowed on deliverable transcripts. Transcribe what was said, or use a {PRO: word} tag.
reasons.NO_DOUBLE_BRACKETS: Doubled tag brackets ([[, ]], <<, >>) are not allowed. Use a single bracket per tag.
reasons.SINGLE_SEGMENT_ONLY: A transcript must be a single segment. Merge these segments into one.
reasons.NON_DELIVERABLE_STYLE_TAG: Style tag is not allowed on deliverable scripts.
reasons.PREAMBLE_WORD: Transcripts must not contain the word "preamble" — it belongs to the script prompt, not the spoken text.
